# NVIDIA FLIP

Public upstream: <https://github.com/NVlabs/flip>

Pinned revision: `b475eb4bf394ab877c42166c9eb0a84a02cc5b14`.
`FLIP.h` is the unmodified upstream `src/cpp/FLIP.h`. `LICENSE` is the upstream BSD-3-Clause license.
Vultra uses the CPU implementation for explicit, untimed LDR-FLIP assessment of tone-mapped linear RGB.
No CUDA, Python or command-line FLIP installation is required.
